title: Grid List
description: Responsive tile grid of cards composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Card, Avatar, Badge, Button, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one card per item with a square avatar, a title, a status badge and an Open action, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the header lines up at @sm, the grid goes to two columns at @md and three at @lg.
